issues.issue: All-funds budget schedule combines the General Fund with the Good Neighbor enterprise fund (actual receipts 15,842,417 vs governmental revenues 2,807,470), but every detail line is tagged governmental. Marked review; a person should decide how to tag a mixed-fund schedule

Grant source not printed. A health department's grants may be largely federal. Judgment call (marked review)
